verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents real-time alerts configured through a project-level Notifications menu, delivered to email, Slack, and PagerDuty (which can create, update, and resolve incidents). Webhooks are noted to fire on the 'same triggers' as other channels, which implies rule triggers exist but does not name them. The evidence never describes per-rule filtering by environment or severity, nor thresholds for new issues, frequency spikes, or affected-user counts. Missing for 10: documented environment/severity filters on notification rules, per-rule trigger types (new item, frequency spike/rate threshold, affected-user count), independent or hands-on corroboration.
